RECOMMENDER has access to:

- Seeker greeted them and said they were looking for a children’s movie for their little brother, whom they are babysitting tonight.
- Seeker returned their “Happy New Year” greeting.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *The Secret Life of Pets* (2016).
- Seeker said they were not really a fan; they liked the first half hour but thought it got a little weird.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *Minions* (2015) and said those movies are hilarious.
- Seeker said yes, their brother had dressed up as a Minion for Halloween because he liked it so much.
- RECOMMENDER mentioned that their own son is really into *Cars 3* (2017).
- Seeker said they hadn’t seen *Cars 3* but had seen the first *Cars* movie and really liked it, and would definitely keep *Cars 3* as a possibility.
